missions.name: Dead Stock Detection
missions.query: Find all products with stock count below reorder point, across all locations, for the past 6 months.

missions.name: Sizing Anomalies
missions.query: Identify products with significant price differences (> 20%) between small and large sizes, across all categories.

missions.name: Supplier Delays
missions.query: Find suppliers with lead time days greater than 30, and on-time delivery rate below 80%, for the past 3 months.

missions.name: Reorder Point Breaches
missions.query: Determine the number of times reorder points have been breached across all products, in the past quarter.

missions.name: Stock Availability by Category
missions.query: Show stock availability (count and percentage) for each category, across all locations, for the past month.

missions.name: Price Variability by Supplier
missions.query: Calculate price variability (coefficient of variation) for each supplier, across all products, in the past 6 months.

missions.name: Supplier Lead Time and On-time Delivery
missions.query: Analyze the relationship between supplier lead time days and on-time delivery rate, across all products, in the past quarter.

missions.name: Last Restocked Analysis
missions.query: Determine the number of products with last restocked dates older than 90 days, across all locations, for the past 6 months.
